name: How long does a typical home remodeling project take with a general contractor?

mainEntity.name: How long does a typical home remodeling project take with a general contractor?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of a home remodeling project depends heavily on its size and complexity. A small bathroom remodel might take 3-6 weeks, while a major kitchen renovation could take 8-16 weeks. Larger projects, such as a whole-house remodel or adding an extension, can extend from several months to over a year. The general contractor provides a detailed timeline during the planning phase, which accounts for design, permitting, material procurement, and construction phases.
acceptedAnswer.description: Project duration varies by scope; small remodels take weeks, while larger projects can take months or over a year. A timeline is provided during planning.
